info.title: Lupin The IIIrd - The Movie: La Stirpe Immortale
info.synopsis: Lupin III e i suoi compagni partono alla volta di un’isola misteriosa nel Mare delle Bermuda, alla ricerca di un grande tesoro e del genio criminale che li ha presi di mira. Dopo essere stati abbattuti in volo, precipitano su un’isola apocalittica, piena di armi abbandonate e avvolta da una nebbia velenosa che uccide in 24 ore. A governarla è Muom, un sovrano che sogna l’immortalità e il dominio sul mondo. Intrappolato e senza via di fuga, Lupin dovrà affidarsi solo alla sua astuzia per sconfiggere un nemico apparentemente invincibile...

episodes.title: LUPIN THE IIIRD: Zenigata and the Two Lupins

tvdb.title: LUPIN THE IIIRD: Zenigata and the Two Lupins
tvdb.synopsis: Inspector Zenigata encounters a terrorist attack at the airport of the Lobbye, and is surprised that the murderer's face was Lupin III. He soon loses sight of it, but finds another “Lupin” at the station and restrains Lupin on the train, but he allows him to escape with the help of Daisuke Dimension. On the other hand, Mine Fujiko infiltrated the circus troupe and was favored by Supreme Leader Breyn as a rider of the aerial swing. With the disarmament treaty parade just around the corner, the National Security Council Karaskov identified and tracked Lupin as a terrorist and a spy of the United States of Alka, but Zenigata was suspicious. Standing in front of Lupin, who was cornered by the National Security Commission in the capital, was a sengata who believed in his innocence. But at that moment, a new explosion hits the sengata...
